description: The agent must: (1) Navigate a messy workspace with 18+ files across nested directories, identify and discard irrelevant distractor content (old SleepWave brief, wrong campaign goals), and synthesize relevant data from at least 6 distinct source files. (2) Produce a `clarity_plus_creative_brief.md` following the exact 5-section structure from the SKILL.md (Campaign Objective Summary → Core Angle & Message Hierarchy → Hook/Scene/Proof Guidance → CTA & Offer Note → Guardrails & Risk Notes), using numbered `## 1.` through `## 5.` headers matching the output-template.md. (3) The Campaign Objective must name first-purchase conversion on Meta Reels as the goal. (4) The Core Angle must surface the non-stimulant differentiator and professional-optimizer audience archetype (28-42, afternoon slump) with a prioritized message hierarchy. (5) The Proof Guidance must include NSF certification AND specific ingredient names (Lion's Mane, Bacopa, L-Theanine) — generic ingredient references are insufficient. (6) The CTA section must include the exact promo code CLARITY20, the 20% discount amount, and the September 30 expiry date. (7) The Guardrails section — the key proprietary trap — must explicitly list: the ban on 'FDA approved' language, the required FDA supplement disclaimer footnote, 'Individual results may vary' for testimonials, and the ban on 'clinically proven' or quantified improvement claims. A generic agent will produce a passable-sounding brief but will miss the compliance-specific guardrails, omit the required FDA disclaimer language, and fail to include the exact promo code and specific proof points.
